headline: Three leaders meet in Shenzhen
notes: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit in Shenzhen on 19 Nov, 90 minutes, joint declaration on UN reform, refined petroleum supply, nuclear war cannot be won, dialogue on nuclear risks.

headline: Iran hits Gulf again
notes: Iran widens attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain; Revolutionary Guard warns Bahrain's monarchy; fight over Strait of Hormuz after US strikes on Qeshm Island.
source_name: Wall Street Journal via Hansen Intel

headline: Myanmar guilty of Rohingya genocide
notes: ICJ in The Hague delivers judgment 19 Nov in The Gambia v Myanmar (2019 Genocide Convention case); 9-6 vote for state responsibility for genocide in northern Rakhine.

headline: Russian military plane crashes, 19 dead
notes: Russian military plane crashes in Siberia killing all 19 aboard, reported 19 Nov.

headline: Kerch rail halted
notes: Third Ukrainian strike in four days halts rail traffic on the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea.

headline: Houthi missile damages Saudi wealth fund tower
notes: Houthi missile attack damages Saudi wealth fund (PIF) tower in Riyadh.

headline: Israel pushes into central Gaza
notes: Israeli tanks push into central Gaza beyond the ceasefire line near Nuseirat; Hamas calls it a violation; Israel says the rare incursion targeted a tunnel.

headline: Nasser Hospital strike kills six
notes: Israeli strike on Gaza's Nasser Hospital kills six, including a surgeon.

headline: Tanker struck in Strait of Hormuz
notes: Tankers reported hit by mines and burning in the Strait of Hormuz.

headline: Herzog meets new Knesset speaker Kahana
notes: President Herzog congratulates Knesset Speaker Matan Kahana on his election during a one-on-one meeting on Thursday 19 Nov. (The election itself was Tuesday 17 Nov, so it is NOT the card; the meeting is.)

headline: Gaza aid score 4 of 26
notes: Five aid organisations give peace-plan implementation 4 out of 26 in a joint review.

headline: UAE economy to grow 7.3%
notes: IMF forecast on the 19 Nov Khaleej Times front page: UAE economy to grow 7.3% next year, 5.4% non-oil GDP growth.

headline: APEC adopts Shenzhen Outlook
notes: APEC leaders adopt the Shenzhen Outlook on trade, data and AI risks; voluntary and non-binding.

headline: Cyclone Akvan weakens before landfall
notes: IMD expects Cyclone Akvan to cross north Andhra Pradesh, Yanam and south Odisha coasts by noon Friday 20 Nov as a severe cyclonic storm, winds 90-100 km/h gusting to 110 km/h.

headline: South Korea court overturns Han Duck-soo sentence
notes: South Korea's Supreme Court overturns former PM Han Duck-soo's 15-year prison sentence over the failed martial law attempt, orders retrial, reaffirms the declaration was unconstitutional.

headline: Mongolia president resigns
notes: Mongolia's parliament accepts President Khurelsukh Ukhnaa's resignation after allegations he financially benefited from a railway project.

headline: Indonesia passes asset-forfeiture bill
notes: Indonesia's parliament approves the asset-forfeiture bill, reported 19 Nov.

headline: Yunus ancestral home set ablaze
notes: Bangladesh tensions: ancestral home of former interim leader Muhammad Yunus set ablaze amid demonstrations.

headline: Sindhu back in world top five
notes: P.V. Sindhu returns to world top five in badminton; Lakshya Sen enters men's top 10.

headline: Serbia elects Cupic speaker 140-97
notes: Aleksandar Cupic of the Student List elected speaker of the new Serbian parliament with 140 votes against 97 for Stojan Radenovic, ending the ruling party's 14-year dominance.

headline: Denmark approves Greenland defence deal
notes: Denmark's parliament (Folketing) approves motion B 36 on 19 Nov by 109 votes to none; expanded US military presence in Greenland, Danish sovereignty kept.

headline: UK tribunal confirms Apple data demand
notes: A London tribunal confirms the British government issued Apple a technical capability notice demanding access to customer data.

headline: Royal Mail names Ablin CEO
notes: Royal Mail owner IDS names finance chief Paul Ablin as CEO; current CEO Alistair Cochrane retires end of 2026, Ablin takes over January 2027.

headline: Coalition of the willing gathers in Berlin
notes: Leaders of the coalition of the willing countries supporting Ukraine gather in Berlin as the Shenzhen talks conclude.

headline: Tiafoe beats Cobolli, Alcaraz into semis
notes: ATP Finals Turin: Frances Tiafoe beats Flavio Cobolli 7-6(6), 6-0; the win sends Carlos Alcaraz to the semi-finals.

headline: Shelton beats Jodar in Turin
notes: ATP Finals Turin, John McEnroe Group round 3: Ben Shelton beats Rafael Jodar 2-0 on 19 Nov.

headline: Somalia expels UAE ambassador
notes: Somalia orders the UAE ambassador to leave within 72 hours and recalls its own envoy, accusing Abu Dhabi of undermining Somali sovereignty.

headline: Senegal president enacts budget by decree
notes: Senegal's President Diomaye Faye decides to implement the revised 2026 budget bill by decree.

headline: Jepchirchir banned three years for doping
notes: Kenyan marathon champion Peres Jepchirchir suspended for three years over a doping violation.

headline: Clashes reported near Badme
notes: Conflict monitors say Ethiopia and Eritrea gathered forces along their border, with unconfirmed reports of clashes near Badme, which Eritrea dismisses as propaganda. Card reports the claim as a report, with Eritrea's denial in the body.

headline: Trump opposes global AI regulation
notes: US President Donald Trump states the United States opposes global regulation of artificial intelligence.

headline: US pursues $2bn+ Philippines loan package
notes: White House announces the US and the Philippines will pursue a loan package exceeding $2 billion through FMF; no disbursement announced.

headline: US denies Essequibo policy shift
notes: A former Trump administration official reportedly suggested Guyana cede part of the Essequibo region to Venezuela; the State Department says US policy has not changed.

headline: Storm Xavier: Nassau under storm alert
notes: Bulletin 36 upgrades Nassau to a storm alert as Storm Xavier approaches the Bahamas.

headline: Trump says Iran exploring chemical and biological weapons
notes: Trump says Iran is exploring chemical and biological weapons. Card states it as Trump's claim, not as established fact.

headline: Fiji declares disaster over El Nino drought
notes: Fiji declares a national state of disaster over the El Nino drought.

headline: New Zealand 243 for 5 on day one
notes: First Test, Wellington: New Zealand ends day one at 243 for 5 against India; Henry Nicholls scores a century, Glenn Phillips nears his own.

headline: Muslims projected largest faith group by 2035
notes: Pew Research Center projections: Muslims will outnumber Christians worldwide by 2035 due to fertility rate differences.

headline: 589 million children lived in conflict zones in 2025
notes: Save the Children report: 589 million children lived in conflict zones in 2025, a global share of 23.4%.

headline: NASA sets coverage for Northrop Grumman CRS-25
notes: NASA sets coverage for the Northrop Grumman CRS-25 cargo launch from Cape Canaveral.
